description: Na₂W₂O₅ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-3.00 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.90 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.91 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.96 Å. There are four inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one WO₄ trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-20°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.10 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one WO₄ trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-20°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.12 Å. In the third W site, W is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing WO₄ trigonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-14°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.08 Å. In the fourth W site, W is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.17 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and two W atoms to form distorted ONa₄W₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₄W₂ octahedra, corners with four ONa₂W₂ trigonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₄W₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-2°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and two W atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two W atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two W atoms to form distorted ONa₄W₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₄W₂ octahedra, corners with four ONa₂W₂ trigonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₄W₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-2°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two W atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two W atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three Na and two W atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two W atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to two Na and two W atoms to form distorted ONa₂W₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with four ONa₄W₂ octahedra and corners with two equivalent ONa₂W₂ trigonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-81°. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to two Na and two W atoms to form ONa₂W₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with four ONa₄W₂ octahedra and corners with two equivalent ONa₂W₂ trigonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-59°.
